Import Duties & Taxes — Poland

📋 Key Tax Information

10% duty on cars from China. 23% VAT applies.

Regulations

EU WVTA required. Euro 6 standard. Individual homologation possible.

6-Step Import Process

1

Select Your Vehicle

Browse our catalog and choose from 18+ Chinese car models available for export to Poland. We'll provide a detailed CIF quote within 24 hours.

2

Confirm Order & Payment

Sign the proforma invoice and make a 30% deposit via T/T bank transfer. We'll begin vehicle procurement from authorized dealers.

3

Quality Inspection

Our team conducts a comprehensive pre-shipment inspection covering exterior, interior, mechanical systems, and documentation. Photos and video provided.

4

Shipping & Documentation

Vehicle shipped via RORO or container from Ningbo/Shanghai port. We prepare all export documents: Bill of Lading, Certificate of Origin, Commercial Invoice, Packing List.

5

Customs Clearance

Upon arrival at Warsaw port, our logistics partner handles customs clearance. Import duty: 10% (EU standard). All fees transparent and pre-quoted.

6

Delivery & Registration

Vehicle delivered to your location in Poland. We provide all documents needed for local registration. Balance payment (70%) due upon delivery confirmation.

Required Documents

1. Bill of Lading (Original)
2. Commercial Invoice (3 copies)
3. Packing List
4. Certificate of Origin (China)
5. Vehicle Title / Ownership Certificate
6. Export Declaration Form
7. Pre-Shipment Inspection Certificate
8. Emission Compliance Certificate (Euro 5/6)
9. Poland Import Declaration Form
10. Insurance Certificate

* We handle all documentation preparation. You only need to provide your local import license and buyer identification.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does it cost to import a car from China to Poland? ▼
The total cost includes FOB price (vehicle cost), ocean freight ($900–$2,400 depending on route), marine insurance (~0.3% of vehicle value), and local import duties (10% (EU standard)). For example, a BYD Han (FOB $32,999) would cost approximately $35,000–$37,000 CIF Warsaw. Contact us for an exact quote.
How long does shipping from China to Poland take? ▼
Shipping from Chinese ports (Ningbo/Shanghai) to Warsaw takes approximately 25–40 days depending on the shipping method. RORO (Roll-on/Roll-off) is typically 25–35 days, while container shipping takes 30–40 days. We provide real-time tracking throughout.
What are the import regulations for cars in Poland? ▼
EU WVTA required. Euro 6 standard. Individual homologation possible. Import duty is 10% (EU standard). 10% duty on cars from China. 23% VAT applies. All vehicles must pass a technical inspection upon arrival. We handle all compliance requirements and documentation.
Can I import an electric car to Poland? ▼
Yes, electric vehicles (EVs) are increasingly popular in Poland. 10% duty on cars from China. 23% VAT applies. Popular EV models for Poland include BYD Han, BYD Seal, and BYD Atto 3. EVs often enjoy reduced or zero import duties, making them particularly cost-effective.
Do you provide warranty for cars exported to Poland? ▼
All vehicles come with the manufacturer's standard warranty. We also offer extended warranty packages through our service network. For EV batteries, most manufacturers provide 6–8 year / 150,000 km warranty. We can connect you with authorized service centers in Poland where available.
